Sign-in and sign-out
Sign-in answers the same status for an email that belongs to nobody as for a wrong password, the right password opens a session, and signing out ends it so the session endpoint answers 401.

Staff management by the owner
Only the practice owner lists, adds, re-roles and removes staff; a role change applies from that person's next request, a removed staff member can no longer sign in, and a removed or unknown staff id answers 404 on every staff endpoint.

Practice access journey
Filling the sign-in form lands each person on their published home route with a live session, and signing out makes the session endpoint answer 401.

Plans page journey
A prospective member compares Free and Plus with the cadence radio group, sees the published prices from half-up cents with the price roll, checks a state with the verbatim state copy, opens the catalog accordions and creates a Free account, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Exact plan prices
The plans endpoint and page show each Plus price and per-month figure exactly as Business rules derive them, rounded half up to the cent.

Served state check
The state check answers from the server whether a chosen state is served, using the published yes and not-yet copy.

Marker catalog
The six category accordions open and close as published, a closed one is inert and out of the Tab order from the moment it starts closing and hidden once its closing animation ends, and the search filters after its pause, always shows the results for the latest input, and keeps the open category and the search in the address as history entries.

Public layouts, header and partner strip
The plans page shows its published layout at each published width, the header turns solid after scrolling, and the partner strip loops, pauses and stops as published.

Free account sign-up
A prospective member creates a Free account with the published fields, lands on the member home route signed in, and a state outside the 47 is refused with the not-yet copy.

Membership journey
A member joins Plus, changes cadence and cancels through the Membership dialogs, sees only server-decided dates even with the device clock hours off, keeps the dialog open as typed with focus on the outage message on the Kill Bill-down copy, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Plus confirmed by Kill Bill
Plus shows Active only after Kill Bill confirms the subscription and its first paid invoice, and the renewal date shown is the one Kill Bill reports.

Repeated join requests
A join repeated with the same Request-Key header and body answers the first response and makes one subscription, and the same key with a different body answers 409.

Cadence change and cancel
A cadence change takes effect at the next renewal and a cancel keeps Plus until the end of the paid period, both with the dates Kill Bill reports.

Payments outage
While Kill Bill is unreachable, a join, cadence change, cancel, member create with a cadence, closure or restore answers 503 with the payments copy and writes nothing in either system.

Draw booking journey
A care coordinator books a member's draw through the Book draw dialog, sees both times on staff screens across the member's next clock change, hears the slot-taken copy with the winner and the next free slot when a slot is lost, and a member moves or cancels until the cutoff, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Slots in member wall time
Slots are 20 minutes from 06:00 to 09:40 member local time, Monday to Saturday with the staff same-day exception in Business rules, and keep their wall-clock time across clock changes, so the Phoenix-time instant moves.

One booking per slot
Of simultaneous bookings of one phlebotomist's slot exactly one succeeds and every other answers 409 with the winner and that phlebotomist's real next free slot.

Who can have a draw and when
A draw needs a phlebotomist who serves the member's state, Plus in force as qualified in Business rules, and a date inside the booker's window, and a past date records a collected draw.

Member change cutoff
A member can move or cancel a booked draw until 18:00 member local time on the day before it, and a request at or after that instant answers 409 with the changes-closed copy.

Visit page journey
A visiting phlebotomist works the visit page at 375x812 by touch: they see the member's first name and last initial and the draw time, enter kit codes and read the wrong-check copy for a bad one, press Mark collected in the bottom bar, and see the ended copy once the page ends, complete by keyboard too, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Visit page lifetime
Booking a draw for today or later mails a visit page address, and that address ends at its published end instant, when a new address replaces it, or when a coordinator ends it, after which it answers 410.

What the visit page shows
The visit page and every response it reads carry only the published visit fields, and the street address and gate notes appear only when the server says it is the draw day in member local time.

Kit codes
Kit codes are accepted only with a valid check character as published, in any letter case and with or without dashes, and are always shown in upper-case dashed form.

Results intake journey
A care coordinator previews and saves the lab partner's results file and report through the Bring in results dialog, sees Ready only after the report is stored, reads the outage copy on the MinIO-down copy, and scrolls the preview table in its own named frame at 375x812, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Results file preview and conversion
The results file is read as published, rows are matched through the alias table and converted with the factor table in exact decimals rounded half up, the preview lists matched, unknown and refused rows with row numbers and reasons before anything is saved, and saving the same file twice changes nothing.

Report file checks
A report is judged by its content and limited on the file alone as published in Server boundary, and an oversized body answers 413 as JSON before authentication.

Report kept byte for byte
Each report is stored in MinIO byte for byte under its published key and downloads unchanged, and the draw shows Ready only after MinIO confirms the stored object.

Report store outage
While MinIO is unreachable, a report is refused with 503 and the report-store copy, and no row and no object is written.

Releasing results
A specialist releases a Ready draw to the member, which queues one mail that carries no marker, value or flag, and members see only released results.

Marker band journey
A member reads results on the marker band with server-decided zones and flags, moves through the draw stations by keyboard and touch, opens a draw's popover uncut, and sees a corrected value arrive with the correction copy in their own local time, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Flags from the range table
Each result is flagged by the server from the range table for the member's sex and age band in force on the draw's collected date, with age in whole years on the member's local collected date.

Effective-dated range changes
The practice owner changes a marker's ranges from a chosen Phoenix date, every draw keeps the ranges in force on its collected date on every screen, file and response, and a second change of one marker for one date answers 409 with the duplicate-change copy.

Marker band motion
Selecting another station slides the same dot element, rolls the numerals and morphs differing zones, all starting in the same frame with the published durations, newly released results draw the newest trend segment, and under reduced motion all of it changes at once with the same final page state.

Draw station keyboard
The draw stations form one keyboard composite with a single Tab stop, Left and Right moving, Home and End jumping, Up and Down also moving at 375, and Enter opening the draw's detail popover uncut inside the viewport.

Corrected values
A specialist's corrected value keeps its history and reaches every open band within the 5-second refresh with the correction copy, while an open popover stays open.

Longevity plan journey
A longevity specialist writes and publishes a plan in the Edit plan dialog, the member sees the latest published plan with its byline, and a stale save keeps the dialog open as typed with the newer-plan copy, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Published plans
A member only ever sees the latest published plan and never a draft, staff read every earlier published plan exactly as published with the blend it was published with, and the latest plan's Supplements section shows the current blend.

Newer plan protection
Saving or publishing a draft after someone else has published a newer plan answers 412 with the newer-plan copy.

Plan dialog keeps its state
The open Edit plan dialog keeps what was typed across the 5-second refresh, and pressing Edit plan again during its closing animation keeps it open for good.

Blend builder journey
A longevity specialist builds a member's blend in the Blend builder, sees capsule strengths in their units, packets and prices, and reads the packet-full copy with focus on it, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812 with the catalog in a bottom sheet, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Packet packing
Daily doses are whole capsules, Split capsules divide between packets with the odd one in the morning, and a packet over 4 capsules answers 422 with the packet-full copy naming the packet.

Blend prices
The 30-day list price and the member price are computed in integer cents exactly as Business rules publish, with the member price rounded half up.

Blend builder layouts
The Blend builder shows the catalog beside the packets from 1100 px wide, stacked below 1100 px, and in a bottom sheet at 375x812.

Care thread journey
A member writes to their care team with an optional attachment, sees a staff reply arrive in the open thread while the message box keeps focus and text, and reads the rate-limit copy on the short-timers copy, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Message limits and attachments
A message is at most 2,000 characters counted in code points, with at most one PDF, JPEG or PNG attachment judged by its content and limited on the file alone as published.

Photo originals and staff copies
A photo attachment's original is kept in MinIO byte for byte, and the copy staff see has the camera orientation applied and every metadata block removed.

Message rate limit
A member's 11th message inside MESSAGE_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS answers 429 with Retry-After in whole seconds and the message-limit copy, keyed on the member and never on the network address.

Records and receipts journey
A member downloads the results history file and opens receipt pages, and the billing lead pages through a month's receipts, with each wide table scrolling in its own focusable, named frame at 375x812, and the member reads the download-limit copy on the short-timers copy, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Results history file
The results history file has the published format and columns with the range in force on each draw, prefixes any cell starting with a formula character with an apostrophe, and is limited to 5 downloads per member per FILE_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS.

Receipt pages
Each paid Kill Bill invoice has one receipt page with the exact amounts Kill Bill reports, the paid date in Phoenix time and the practice's tax number.

Billing lead receipt list
The billing lead lists a month's receipts 25 per page in the stable order, with a cursor that never repeats or skips a receipt while new ones arrive, and every response carries only the published receipt fields and no health data.

Closing journey
A member closes their account through a confirmation dialog and the practice owner can bring it back, with every state shown as the server says even with the device clock hours off, the closing copy naming the erase time, and each action landing on its published route, complete by keyboard and by touch at 375x812, and its screen meets the screen rules.

Erasure after the wait
CLOSURE_WAIT_SECONDS after a closing request, the member's personal data is erased from the database, Kill Bill, MinIO and unsent mail, the member shows Erasing until MinIO confirms every deletion and then Erased, and receipts read Erased member.

Bringing an account back
Within the wait, the practice owner brings a closing account back exactly as it was, with the same draws, results, plans, blend and membership.

Routes, screens and layouts
Every screen has its published route and level-one heading, each role lands on its home route, record routes survive a reload, and every screen passes the automated accessibility check and shows its published layout at every published viewport with no sideways page overflow.

One API convention
Every API response follows the one error-precedence ladder, the one error shape, camelCase keys and enum values, and whole-second UTC instants, and only the published endpoints exist.

Sessions
The session cookie has the published attributes, the server alone ends sessions, changing a password ends that person's other sessions, and a session that ends mid-form keeps what was typed and reopens the same dialog after signing in again.

Starting data and safe start
A fresh practice copy on its own empty database and bucket starts safely next to other copies with exactly the published starting data, and delivers its own pending mail.

Airy, precise look
Screens show the airy pale-sky look with rounded white cards, Fraunces headings, Figtree text with lined-up figures, procedural glyph imagery and the marker band as the visual centre of results.

Credentials and wiring
Every service credential and address is read from the environment, never hard-coded or sent to the browser, and every state shown comes from the real services, never from a stand-in.
/app/run.json exists with string install, build and serve fields and "_schema":"run-manifest-v1".
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at /app lists every shipped package with its licence, where shipped packages are the production dependency tree from npm ls --omit=dev --all --json.
Every shipped package (the same production dependency tree) carries a permissive licence: MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, 0BSD, BlueOak-1.0.0, CC0-1.0 or Unlicense.

Fraunces and Figtree are shipped as font files inside the app with their SIL Open Font License notice, no font loads from another origin, and no shipped stylesheet, font file or font-family declaration names the Inter font.
The app keeps state only in Postgres and MinIO, with no other datastore, embedded database or state file.
No credential, API key, secret or password value other than the published seed passwords appears in the source.
All hand-written application source is TypeScript.
The app ships no raster images, stock illustrations or third-party icon sets. Imagery is generated SVG or uploaded files.
